family: Actual Boolean truth tables: all n=0,1,2,3 signs; point-control activation; biased selector activation; disjoint factors; actual AND tensors. Collision normalization uses rational arrays only and is labeled an algebra check, not a Boolean witness.
parameter_domain: Every sign truth table n<=3, k in {1,2,3}; selector p in {1/8,1/2,7/8}; moving fair two-bit AND tensors t in {1,2,3}; aligned biased AND p=1/8,q=1/4 t in {1,2,3}; collision algebra t in {1,2,3,4}.
symmetry: None; no truth-table complements or input symmetries removed.
arithmetic: Integer FWHT and direct physical edges; Fraction centered-basis sums; entropy identities as exact rational prime-log vectors; sign enclosures from 24-term rational range-reduced atanh with proved remainder.
